svg.title: Legend beside vias, over tented vias, and over open vias
svg.desc: Drawn to scale. Three plan views of the same 0603 resistor, R7, with two vias joined to its pads and a third via between them. The designator is 1 mm tall. Left, recommended: the designator sits beside the part on flat solder mask, clear of the vias. Middle, acceptable when there is no other room: the designator is printed across tented vias; it prints, but the ink dips where the mask sags over each hole, so the characters come out slightly distorted and thinner over each via. Right, avoid: the vias are open, so the fab clips the legend about 0.1 mm back from their exposed copper and the designator is cut into pieces. Below, an enlarged cross-section at true scale of a legend line printed across a tented 0.3 mm via: the mask sags into the hole and the legend ink follows it down.

g.text: Over tented vias: only if there's no room
Enlarged, true scale: a legend line across a tented via
Prints, but the ink dips into each via
Clipped back from an open via
The fab removes legend near exposed copper
Ink follows the mask down into the via
So the character is slightly distorted
Solder mask tent over the via
Drawn to scale. Vias 0.3 mm in diameter with 0.6 mm rings. Legend 1 mm tall.
Enlarged view: copper about 50 µm, mask about 25 µm and legend ink about 20 µm (an example).
